records.idCN: 02怪物素材/混厄系列-脑雾孢子
records.name: Brain Fog Spores
records.des: Spores produced by certain Chaos Remains. They may cause inattention and brain fog symptoms. The report states, "Odorless. After I consumed it, I felt completely unmotivated to write the report. I need to take three days off."

records.idCN: 02怪物素材/混厄系列-失忆茎刺
records.name: Amnesia Stem
records.des: A thorn-like organ from certain Chaos Remains. When it stings a victim, it causes them to lose consciousness. The report states, "I can't remember what happened when I consumed it. It seems like I fell unconscious for three days."

records.idCN: 02怪物素材/混厄系列-眩晕甲壳
records.name: Dizzying Carapace
records.des: The armor of certain Chaos Remains. Its dazzling pattern may cause dizziness to those who directly gaze at it. The report states, "After consuming it, I experienced a series of falls and sprained my arms and legs. I need to take a week off."

records.idCN: 02怪物素材/混厄系列-厄运棘冠
records.name: Misfortune Thorn
records.des: A corolla-shaped organ on the head of certain Chaos Remains, with its purpose unknown. Encountering these Chaos Remains is said to bring extreme misfortune within the following days. The report states, "I accidentally bit my tongue while consuming it. I need to take three days off."

records.idCN: 02怪物素材/混厄系列-报丧尖喙
records.name: Mourning Beak
records.des: A beak-shaped organ on the head of certain Chaos Remains. These Chaos Remains can provoke piercing screams directly in the minds of their targets, rendering them unable to focus. The report states, "After I consumed it, a sour flavor attacked my mind and gave me the most terrible headache. I need to take three days off."

Getway.DisplayName: CDCA Bureau BCRL Agency - Aimless Life

records.idCN: 02怪物素材/混厄系列-苦痛镰爪
records.name: Pain Claw
records.des: The claws of certain Chaos Remains. When touched, they inflict overwhelming grief, leading to a loss of motivation and willpower. The report states, "It was salty, like tasting my own tears. I'm feeling utterly miserable now. I need to take three days off."

records.idCN: 02怪物素材/混厄系列-漩涡棘花
records.name: Vortex Flower
records.des: A flower-shaped organ on the head of certain Chaos Remains. When observed, it creates an illusion of vortex in the observer's vision, gradually leading to a state of stupor. The report states, "Its taste was a constant cycle of bitter, sweet, and sour. After that, I drifted into a dream world of giant vortex and slept for three days."

records.idCN: 02怪物素材/混厄系列-暮光坚壳
records.name: Twilight Shell
records.des: The armor of certain Chaos Remains, capable of emitting rays of a specific frequency, which can induce drowsiness in those exposed to them. The report states, "After I consumed it, my mouth exploded with tastes, and I started seeing light spots dancing in front of my eyes. After that, I slept for three days."

Getway.DisplayName: Dropped by Chaos Behemoth and Ganoderma

records.idCN: 02怪物素材/混厄系列-迷失木礁
records.name: Lost Wood Coral
records.des: Flake-like tissue from certain Chaos Remains. It produces hallucinations of scents, yet the affected individuals are unable to determine the source of the aroma, resulting in a loss of direction. The report states, "After consuming it, I smelt the aroma but completely lost the sense of direction. I don't think I can work now. I need to take three days off."

records.idCN: 02怪物素材/混厄系列-视差坚棘壳
records.name: Parallax Shell
records.des: The spiky shell on Chaos Behemoth with an intriguing feature of having a blurred outline. The report states, "After I consumed it, my tongue went numb, worse than when I eat crazy hot peppers, and I couldn't tell the difference between doors and windows. I don't think I can go out in this state, so I need to take three days off."

Getway.DisplayName: CDCA Bureau BCRL Agency - Aimless Life

records.idCN: 02怪物素材/混厄系列-昏聩头壳
records.name: Behemoth Skull
records.des: The hardened shell on the head of Chaos Behemoth. It causes constant noises in the ears and hampers thinking. The report states, "It has a salty and sour flavor. After I consumed it, my mind got bombarded with tinnitus and I couldn't sleep at all. I didn't even hear my alarm clock the next day and ended up late for work. I need to take a day off."

Getway.DisplayName: CDCA Bureau BCRL Agency - Aimless Life

records.idCN: 02怪物素材/混厄系列-薄暮坚棘刺
records.name: Dusk Spike
records.des: This organ has the ability to dim the light surrounding Chaos Ganoderma, aiding Chaos Remains in concealing themselves. The reports stats, "Odorless with a cool aftertaste. After I consumed it, my computer went all haywire with a mysterious blank screen, and I can't get any work done like this. I need to take three days off."

records.idCN: 02怪物素材/混厄系列-游星之眼
records.name: Floating Star
records.des: This organ emits floating light spots near Chaos Ganoderma, causing skin burns upon contact. The report states, "Pungent with a bitter taste. After consuming it, I started seeing light spots, and I could actually gather them with my mind. Later, a mysterious explosion occurred where the light spots gathered. My entire group needs to take three days off."

records.idCN: 02怪物素材/骨龙系列-海龙鳍条

records.des: This organ serves a similar function to the flagellum of Chaos Remains, enabling its possessor to "swim" in the morphic field with greater power and speed.

Getway.DisplayName: Anita Launch Center BCRL Agency - Dragon Shadow

records.idCN: 02怪物素材/骨龙系列-海龙尾鳍

Getway.DisplayName: Anita Launch Center BCRL Agency - Dragon Shadow

Getway.DisplayName: Anita Launch Center BCRL Agency - Chained Ghost

records.des: Substances extracted from materials associated with Deep Sleepers, possessing significant value due to the challenging extraction process. A particular researcher tasted it and submitted a report stating, "Eating this substance will lead you into a deep slumber where your wishes come true in your dreams, but it will render you unconscious for a day. It has a sweet taste."

Getway.DisplayName: Anita Extractor - DS Essence Extraction Method

records.name: Ancestor's Root
records.des: The root-like tissue that grows from the head of Ancestor's Retribution, resembling the materials extracted from typical Deep Sleepers but considerably tougher.\nThe research states, "Don't eat it for your digestive and dental health, because it has a flavor reminiscent of vomit mixed with alcohol."

records.idCN: 01势力素材/深眠4级-远祖的悔罪
records.name: Ancestor's Regret
records.des: The weapon wielded by Ancestor's Retribution, remarkably well-preserved despite its extensive history. Recognizable for its distinct Mundus Empire style, it carries an inscription, "My remorse. My bloodland. My distant homeworld."

records.idCN: 03制造素材/机械系列-屠戮链锯
records.name: Slayer's Chainsaw
records.des: A hefty weapon taken from Slayer, demanding considerable strength to wield. Although it is capable of slicing through materials, using it in such a manner would squander its tremendous power...

records.idCN: 02怪物素材/黑月系列-无明火帽子
records.name: Stealth Kasa
records.des: A specialized hat provided to selected Night Chains Executors to aid in concealment during darkness. It's essentially a camouflage tool with distinct appearance.

Ranshin City BCRL Agency Moon Shade

Getway.DisplayName: CDCA Bureau BCRL Agency - Blade Clash
Ranshin City BCRL Agency Moon Shade
